clauses.reason: Section 1 amends the first clause of the preamble to Executive Order 13851 (Nicaragua) by restating the authorities under which it is issued. The amendment took effect on signing, October 24, 2022, and the amended provisions of Executive Order 13851 continue in force with the parent order. No held instrument revokes, supersedes, amends or limits this clause. The national emergency declared in Executive Order 13851, on which the order acts, was continued, with express reference to Executive Order 14088, by the Federal Register notices of November 10, 2022, November 16, 2023, November 22, 2024 and November 20, 2025; the last, dated November 20, 2025 (90 FR 53193), continues it beyond November 27, 2025 for 1 year, which covers 2026-10-14. A Treasury notice published April 21, 2026 (91 FR 21369) records designations under Executive Order 13851 as amended by Executive Order 14088. The clause was therefore operative on 2026-10-14.
